findings.finding: The new configured initial energy55 made two old ownership tests hardcoded to100 fail.
findings.resolution: Ownership tests now compare against REST_RULES.startingEnergy and still assert cloned snapshots cannot mutate authority. No game recovery from food/water alone; updated tests prove energy declines with no rest.

findings.finding: An initial fixture assertion demanded new food/water consumption during a short rest even when birds could already be satisfied.
findings.resolution: Removed that incorrect demand before browser acceptance. Strict sustained-needs and urgent food AND water interruption remain separately tested; browser verifies independent conserved stock and nondecreasing real consumption counters.

findings.finding: Rest test reached6PASS cases (real rest/enrichment) then expected normal status wording after deliberately issuing duplicate Confirm. UI correctly displayed translated stale-command feedback instead.
findings.resolution: Fixture now verifies the actual localized normal or stale feedback. Full source-bound QA rerun; same production build, new validation-source identity. Original FAIL/partial receipts and actual native photo preserved separately, never promoted as final PASS.

findings.finding: Engineer started the landscape feeding scenario while the animal scenario was still RUNNING. The mixed result was invalidated, not used for acceptance.
findings.resolution: Raw overlap receipt retained at attempts/landscape-overlap-attempt.json. Closed the session and reloaded; complete landscape matrix rerun sequentially, waiting for each final PASS before starting the next. Final source/build identities remained unchanged.

findings.finding: First qa:verify rejected the empty console receipt because it used limitPerRead instead of the required numeric limit field.
findings.resolution: Added limit:200, matching the actual uncapped browser log calls. No observations, screenshots, timestamps, source or build changed. Verification-attempts.jsonl preserves the FAIL and subsequent PASS.
